name: nexus-desktop
description: Local Nexus capability routing with bounded Host-visible inventory assessment, host-owned execution handoff, and post-validation enhancement handoff for ChatGPT Desktop and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Route substantive work with verified local capability evidence.
interface.longDescription: Nexus is a local routing and Host-handoff plugin. It can assess a bounded current-turn subset of metadata already surfaced by ChatGPT Desktop, but cannot enumerate private Host state. Its read/plan-and-handoff-only local MCP server exposes no remote endpoint and never performs execution, artifact mutation, or validation; ChatGPT Host retains artifact and tool authority.
defaultPrompt: Use Nexus to create an editable PowerPoint presentation.
Use Nexus to plan a backend bug fix with regression tests.
